headline: Referred to the people-operations lead, who 'may have been looking at a solution'

suggested_routes.label: Deal / partner next step
suggested_routes.rationale: The prospect referred Meera to a colleague who handles frontline processes and locations, and may already be evaluating.
suggested_routes.evidence_ref: C08 — "If you send him a proposal and say you spoke with me, he can take a look."
suggested_routes.output: Next step (owner: Meera, stated): send the proposal to the confirmed address and reference Raghav, as he explicitly allowed. Ask the colleague what solution they were already evaluating.

suggested_routes.label: Sales coaching
suggested_routes.rationale: Good practice worth reinforcing: clear positioning against the existing system and an email read-back.
suggested_routes.output: Reinforce with Meera and the team: she positioned SpendNest alongside the prospect's existing system instead of as a replacement, and read the email back to confirm it.

evidence.quote: Is this an enterprise management system? We position it alongside one.
evidence.supports: Clear positioning against the existing system.

evidence.quote: I think we may have been looking at a solution, but I don't know the details.
If you send him a proposal and say you spoke with me, he can take a look.
evidence.supports: Referral with permission to use the name.

evidence.quote: Let me read it back to make sure I have the right address

concise_output: Meera's cold call to Raghav produced a warm referral to the colleague handling people operations and locations, who may already be looking at a solution. A proposal is to be sent naming Raghav.
what_established: Raghav asked for a proposal by email, gave permission to mention him, and said there have been some internal discussions.
what_not_established: Whether an evaluation is actually active, its timing, or the colleague's authority.
next_action: Meera emails the proposal naming Raghav; asks what was being evaluated.
uncertainty: The prospect's knowledge of the internal evaluation is second-hand ("I don't know the details").
label_check: Stored observed_outcome 'referred' agrees with the text.
